contentText: US President Donald Trump's actions during his first year back in office have been "faster and more shocking than we even expected". That's the view of US domestic and foreign policy specialist Laurie Dundon. She told us that Trump's mind is set on the historical legacy he will leave and that he aims to upend how the US functions internally and how it is seen in the world. She spoke to us in Perspective.
